verdict.summary: The advisory lane is internally consistent: jscpd is exactly version-pinned, its threshold failure is intentionally contained, missing/invalid and vacuous reports are explicitly identified rather than presented as clean results, and the JSON summary separates markdown-class findings from fenced-code formats. The configuration scope and reachable nested-target exclusion match the workflow documentation, while the advisory registry limits any future promotion to the exact fenced-code half.
